newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger to close down two plants.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger to close down two plants.

text.p: Austrian brickmaker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie AG said on Wednesday it would close down two plants in the southern province of Styria by October due to the sluggish economy.
The two plants of Wienerberger Ziegelindustrie, the parent's brickmaking division, are in Gasselsdorf and Mitterdorf.
Wienerberger Ziegelindustrie chief executive Johannes Windisch told Reuters the plants were the group's smallest and least efficient and that a total of 20 jobs would be lost.

Wienerberger, now the world's largest manufacturer of bricks after an aggressive expansion campaign, was forced into the closures by the continued slump in the construction industry and by stricter environmental laws meaning costly investment to bring old factories into line. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
